overloadMerges.note: left, top, right and bottom are all documented with the '←' arrow (values returned by the command), not '→'; auto-parse defaulted all of them to direction 'in'. Documents their sentinel values (0 and -1 special cases) explicitly.

params.name: left
params.description: Column number that is the left boundary of the selection

params.name: top
params.description: Row number that is the top boundary of the selection

sentinelValues.meaning: The entire column is selected (and, if left also equals 0, the entire area is highlighted)

params.name: right
params.description: Column number that is the right boundary of the selection

params.name: bottom
params.description: Row number that is the bottom boundary of the selection

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the cell-range coordinates of the currently selected cell(s) in area, using 0 as a whole-row/whole-column/whole-area sentinel and -1 for all four outputs when there is no selection.
